nodes.label: Guide / Tutorial Screen (Panduan)
nodes.description: UI design screenshot of the guide/tutorial (Panduan) screen from the Smart Plant Disease app. Features: green header bar with back arrow and 'Panduan' title in white bold text. White background main content area with numbered step-by-step tutorial instructions in Indonesian. Each step has a large green number badge, instructional text, and an accompanying illustration/screenshot. Steps teach users how to use the plant disease detection feature. Bottom navigation bar consistent with rest of app. Green and white color scheme.

edges.note: The Panduan guide screen documents how to use the app, starting from plant selection (Beranda screen)
The Panduan guide teaches users how to reach and interpret the disease detection result screen
